title: Closest to the 52-week high
author: arhancanli
rationale: Holds the stocks trading closest to their highest price of the past year. Investors may anchor on that high and be slow to act on good news when a price nears it.
risks: It leans towards recent winners, so it can share momentum's sudden falls. A universe with few stocks can leave it holding just a few names.
references: George and Hwang (2004), The 52-Week High and Momentum Investing, Journal of Finance
